**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 19:40
- [USER] User asked how to make the ultimate DIY laundry detergent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Making your own laundry detergent can be a fun and cost-effective way to keep your clothes clean.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe for DIY laundry detergent includes:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients:
    - 1 cup washing soda
    - 1 cup borax
    - 1 bar of soap (such as Fels-Naptha or Zote)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for making laundry detergent:
  1. Grate the bar of soap using a cheese grater.
  2. In a large bowl, mix together the grated soap, washing soda, and borax until well combined.
  3. Store the mixture in an airtight container.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To use the homemade detergent:
  1. Add 1-2 tablespoons of the homemade detergent to your washing machine depending on the size of your load and how dirty the clothes are.
  2. Wash your clothes as you normally would.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notes about the recipe:
  - This recipe makes approximately 3 cups of detergent, which should last for quite a few loads.
  - You can use any bar soap you like, but it's recommended to use a pure soap without added fragrance or moisturizing properties.
  - Washing soda and borax can usually be found in the laundry aisle of most grocery stores.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] By making your own laundry detergent, you can customize it to your preferences by adding essential oils for fragrance or using a different type of soap.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested to test the detergent on a small area of fabric first to ensure it doesn't cause any damage.
- [USER] User asked about the main ingredients in laundry detergent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Main ingredients in laundry detergent typically include:
  1. Surfactants: Primary cleaning agents that help remove dirt and stains.
  2. Builders: Enhance the effectiveness of surfactants and soften water.
  3. Enzymes: Help break down protein-based stains.
  4. Optical brighteners: Make whites appear brighter and colors more vivid.
  5. Fragrances: Provide a fresh, clean scent.
  6. Fillers: Increase the volume of the product.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The exact composition of laundry detergent can vary depending on the brand and type of detergent, as well as the country where it is sold.
